text_block_list.text:
The new year had begun, and Kitasan Black 
had entered the Classic Year. This year is 
an important year for an Umamusume.

In order to make a giant leap forward, 
first we must firmly establish our 
goals...
(CLATTER-CLATTER-CLANK!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Happy New Year! I want to make my 
New Year's resolutions right away!

As expected of Kitasan Black. Her resolve 
in that regard was flawless.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "And so, let's head over. To my place!"

text_block_list.name: Disciples
text_block_list.text: Master, Happy New Year!

I was suddenly brought along to her 
family's New Year's party. Kitasan Black's 
father's top apprentice greeted us...

text_block_list.name: Top Disciple
text_block_list.text: Milady, congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year! This is my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We came together today to make our New 
Year's resolution to Dad!

text_block_list.name: Top Disciple
text_block_list.text:
A vow, you say? Well then, let's see. 
Since we have the chance...

text_block_list.name: Top Disciple
text_block_list.text:
How about the two of you express your 
enthusiasm for this year through song?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Singing a song with just the two of us, 
Trainer!? Singing in front of Father and 
his disciples makes me a little nervous, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, I want to put my whole heart into 
singing! Trainer-san, would that be okay?

"Singing among professionals takes 
considerable courage. Still, I'll steel my 
resolve and sing a duet with them."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, which one should I go with...? 
Trainer, between this, this, and this, 
which one do you think is best?

Out of the three songs Kitasan Black 
proposed as candidates, the one chosen 
was...
choice_data_list: A 1-hour medley of your dad's songs.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“The One Who Left in Seconds”! You picked 
an interesting one. Well then, let's sing!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"On the day we met~♪ Our eyes locked in a 
gaze~♪"
choice_data_list:
Falling in love~ without a moment to 
spare~♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
She leftttt! Haaaaah! She was gone in a 
seconddd, that persoooon♪

text_block_list.name: Top Disciple
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! Milady, Trainer, you two were 
quite in sync, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Top Disciple
text_block_list.text:
To take off in mere seconds, she's quite 
the speedster. Please show Pops that kind 
of spirited racing this year.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I promise!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go at a blinding, 
blink-and-you'll-miss-it pace this year!

I'll leave the other Umamusume in the dust 
within seconds. Such was the resolution I 
made for the New Year.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A one-hour medley of Dad's songs! Ooh, 
that sounds great!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I can sing the whole thing from 
memory without looking at the lyrics! 
Let's see this through to the end!
After an hour of passionate singing—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ Totally satisfied!! Thank you for 
listening, everyone!
(WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Top Disciple
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... You both have incredible stamina. 
To actually sing every single song to the 
end.

text_block_list.name: Top Disciple
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, you should be able to run 
it through this year. Come now, rest up 
for the rest of the day."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Trainer, let's give it our 
absolute all this year!

Vowing to run my heart out to the end, 
just like this medley, I spent the rest of 
my time relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I am the sea, Mother"! What a grand, 
sweeping song. Let's sing it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I aaaam the ooocean~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Swallowing up~ all the sorrow~âª 
Overcoming~ every slope~âª

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah, carrying on living~♪

text_block_list.name: Top Disciple
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, what a splendid performance that 
was. Truly magnificent and dignified.

text_block_list.name: Top Disciple
text_block_list.text:
Show the old man this year that neither of 
you will ever run away from anything.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I promise!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, like the vast ocean, let's go 
with a massive boom!

Starting off the New Year, my motivation 
surged dramatically, and a strong sense of 
challenge welled up inside me!
